notes: POC summary: Hosted API trial successful for functionality; primary ask now is predictable economics and guaranteed throughput.
Traffic profile observed during 14-day trial: average QPS ~12, typical concurrency 8, short bursts to 60 QPS during peak playground sessions.
Token mix observed (sampled): avg prompt tokens 120, avg completion tokens 280 (approx 30% prompt / 70% completion).
Monthly extrapolation from active cohort: ~8M API calls/month -> ~3.2B tokens/month (approx). Customer wants sizing for steady-state + 3x burst headroom.
Latency SLOs: target p95 < 180ms for short chat completions; p99 < 400ms acceptable. Prefers <200ms for UI feel.
Model preferences: leaning to open-weight 4-bit quantized models (Llama2-13B-4bit or Mistral-7B quant) for cost tradeoff; willing to test a 70B variant for high-quality summarization path.
Cost sensitivity: CTO comment — 'predictable monthly bill more important than micro-optimizations; want unit economics to be < $0.10 / 1k tokens effective for steady-state'.

Dedicated ask: sizing recommendation for steady 12 QPS with 3x burst to 36-48 QPS, sustained concurrency target 24, low latency. Interested in 2 dedicated GPU nodes with autoscale to 4 during bursts, preferred hardware equivalence A10/A100 class.
Routing: need policy for fallback to smaller models in burst; want region-aware routing (NA primary, EU residency for EU customers).
Security: SSO/SAML mandatory, KMS for key management, audit logs, retention controls. Data residency required for EU customers — must support EU-only routing for that tenant subset.
Quote from Head of Infra: 'can't have surprise spikes — need committed baseline with defined burst billing and clear throttling behavior.'
Next steps logged: AE to deliver capacity plan + 3 pricing scenarios (conservative, expected, aggressive). SE to run a benchmark harness on suggested quantized models with customer sample prompts.
Open items: exact expected monthly active users, internal approval timeline for capex, confirmation of encryption at rest requirements for on-prem-like PII handlers.
technical_spec_summary: Observed trial metrics: avg latency (hosted) 210ms, p95 340ms under hosted trial traffic; peak p99 spikes to ~750ms during playground bursts.
Target capacity: steady 12 QPS -> baseline instance pool; recommend 2 dedicated nodes (4 vGPU-equivalent) to meet latency SLOs with 3x burst autoscale to 4 nodes.
Token forecast: steady 3.2B tokens/month; plan capacity for 4B tokens to include growth + margin.
Concurrency planning: test harness shows 24 concurrent open requests drives p95 > 400ms on a single node for larger models; recommend horizontal shards.
Caching: high reuse of prompts detected for help-center responses — opportunity for prefix/KV caching to reduce per-token compute by ~12-18%.
Batching: recommend adaptive batching with target max latency budget 120ms for frontend-critical calls; background summarization can use larger batch sizes.
Fallback policy: primary model (quantized 13B) -> fallback to 7B quantized for bursts -> optional call to higher-quality 70B for nightly summarization jobs.
Monitoring: request CPU/GPU util, token-per-second, request qps, tail latency per model; need per-route dashboards in Console and alert for p99 > 600ms.
